window-1.title: Piano Keyboard 🎹 — dweet d/35177 by dee-gomma
window-1.blurb: Someone built a whole animated piano in 140 characters of code, and there's a remix button right there — which means you're about six minutes away from a new side quest.

window-2.title: Announcing the 2026 LensCulture Art Photography Award Winners
window-2.blurb: A fresh dump of photographers nobody's told you about yet — staged worlds, strange grain, invented selves — basically a scroll designed to give you your next shoot idea before you finish it.

window-3.title: Sparkling Hibiscus Sangria Mocktail
window-3.blurb: It's a whole magenta pitcher of hibiscus and floating fruit — basically built to be batched for your people, photographed on 35mm, and refilled twice before anyone notices there's no booze in it.

window-4.title: Apartamento × LOEWE: Carlota Guerrero at Home, shot by Coco Capitán
window-4.blurb: Three women artists photographed inside their own homes by Coco Capitán — rooms styled like self-portraits, which is basically your whole thesis on living, so go build yourself a corner that photographs like a story about you.
